prompt:
You are a credit rating analyst. Using only the information below and general knowledge predating 2026-02-04, assign the issuer a letter credit rating on the 21-grade scale below (finest granularity you can justify).
Valid answers (choose exactly one): AAA, AA+, AA, AA-, A+, A, A-, BBB+, BBB, BBB-, BB+, BB, BB-, B+, B, B-, CCC+, CCC, CCC-, CC, C.
Company information (as of 2026-02-04):
Fiscal period 2025 Q4 (filed 2026-02-04). Revenue 10,496M, gross margin 28%, operating income 979M (operating margin 9%), net income 665M, diluted EPS 0.51. Total assets 71,487M, total liabilities 45,596M, shareholders' equity 25,838M. Current assets 12,951M vs current liabilities 21,864M (current ratio 0.59), retained earnings 36,413M.
Reason briefly in 1-3 sentences. Then, on a separate final line, output exactly:
DECISION: <one label>
raw_response:
The reported metrics show positive operating profitability (9% margin) and a solid equity cushion (leverage ~1.76× assets/equity), supporting an investment-grade profile, but the sub-1× current ratio signals material refinancing/liquidity risk that prevents a higher rating.
DECISION: BBB
